ctx.x: Yeah, I played in there, with Willie and them. Well, I got right smart away, but still it wasn't enough to do any good. And it was a good while before guys knew that you were back in town. So I went on and I played around with Howard. Then I started going, making trips with Isaiah Morgan, with Sam Morgan's brother, the Buggaloos. Sam and other people. Sam and different places. And with George William. And finally I got on the WPA, not in the band, but I got on the WPA project down there, on the music project.…
A lot of the musicians were in there. Were you in that too?
